summary_zh: 本页为绘本标题页，显示标题“美人计”，并配有一名身着橙色古装、低头垂泪的女子插图。

page_text_ocr_zh:
西周的时候，有一年，
都城镐京发生了大地震。
巨大的石头从山上滚下来，地上裂开一道道大
口子，泾河、渭河、洛河的水都流干了。
无数房屋哗啦啦倒塌，
就连周朝的发源地岐山
也崩塌了，许多百姓被
压在了山下面。
page_text_en:
During the Western Zhou dynasty, one year,
the capital Haojing experienced a great earthquake.
Huge rocks rolled down from the mountains, cracking the ground open into large fissures; the waters of the Jing River, Wei River, and Luo River all dried up.
Countless houses collapsed with a loud crash,
even the Zhou dynasty's birthplace, Mount Qi,
collapsed, and many civilians were
buried under the mountains.
summary_zh: 本页描述了西周时期都城镐京发生大地震的惨状：山石滚落、地面开裂、河流干涸、房屋倒塌，连周朝发源地岐山也崩塌，许多百姓被压在山下。

page_text_ocr_zh: 周幽王听到灾情后，却毫不在乎地对大臣们说："山崩地裂，都是小事，你们看着办吧！"原来，他正忙着派人四处寻访美女呢！
page_text_en: King You of Zhou, upon hearing of the disaster, carelessly told his ministers: "Mountains collapsing and the earth cracking are trivial matters. You handle it yourselves!" In fact, he was busy sending people out to search for beautiful women!
summary_zh: 周幽王在得知镐京大地震的灾情后，毫不在意，反而继续派人四处寻找美女，表现出对百姓苦难的漠视。

page_text_ocr_zh: 西周大夫褒珦劝周幽王说：‘大王，您现在需要的是有才能的贤臣，而不是美人呀！’周幽王听了大怒，下令将他关进死牢。为了救出褒珦，他的儿子褒洪德苦苦地哀求周幽王，愿意将家中的金银财宝全都献出来。见周幽王还不满足，洪德又去深山为他寻来了珍奇鸟兽。可是三年过去了，周幽王还是不肯放褒珦。
page_text_en: The Western Zhou official Bao Xiang advised King You: 'Your Majesty, what you need now are capable and virtuous ministers, not beautiful women!' King You became furious upon hearing this and ordered him imprisoned in a death cell. To save Bao Xiang, his son Bao Hongde desperately pleaded with King You, offering to surrender all the family's gold, silver, and treasures. Seeing that King You was still not satisfied, Hongde went deep into the mountains to find rare birds and beasts for him. Yet, after three years had passed, King You still refused to release Bao Xiang.
summary_zh: 西周大夫褒珦劝谏周幽王应重用贤臣而非寻觅美女，周幽王大怒将其关入死牢。褒珦之子褒洪德为救父，先后献出家中财宝和珍奇鸟兽，但周幽王仍不放人。

page_text_ocr_zh: 一天，洪德路过一条小河，正好有个姑娘在河边打水。她虽然穿着粗布衣服，但是唇红齿白，身姿窈窕，像天上的仙女一样美丽。洪德灵机一动，想道：‘如果将这个美人献给周幽王，说不定就可以救出父亲了。’
page_text_en: One day, Hongde passed by a small river, and just then a girl was fetching water by the riverbank. Though she wore rough cloth clothes, she had rosy lips and white teeth, a graceful figure, as beautiful as a fairy from heaven. Hongde had a sudden idea and thought: 'If I present this beauty to King You of Zhou, perhaps I can rescue my father.'
summary_zh: 洪德在河边遇见一位容貌美丽的女子，他灵机一动，决定将她献给周幽王以换取父亲的自由。

page_text_ocr_zh: 于是，洪德就用三百匹布帛，把这个姑娘买回了家。这个姑娘的名字叫褒姒。褒姒来到洪德家，用鲜花泡水沐浴，换上绸缎锦衣，涂上胭脂口红，戴上翡翠耳环……啊，真是人比花美，楚楚动人呀！
page_text_en: Then, Hongde bought this girl home with three hundred bolts of silk. The girl's name was Bao Si. When Bao Si arrived at Hongde's home, she took a bath in water infused with flowers, changed into silk robes, applied rouge and lipstick, and put on jade earrings... Ah, she was truly more beautiful than flowers, graceful and enchanting!
summary_zh: 洪德用三百匹布帛买下名叫褒姒的女子，并为她沐浴、换上华服、佩戴首饰，使其容貌更加动人。

page_text_ocr_zh: 洪德带着美丽的褒姒去见周幽王。周幽王惊呆了，他见过无数美人，可她们都比不上褒姒的万分之一。周幽王立刻放出了褒姒，还让他做回了原来的官职。从此以后，褒姒就住进了王宫。
page_text_en: Hongde brought the beautiful Bao Si to meet King You of Zhou. King You was stunned; he had seen countless beauties, but none could compare to even one ten-thousandth of Bao Si. King You immediately released Bao Si and restored him to his former position. From then on, Bao Si lived in the palace.
summary_zh: 洪德将美女褒姒献给周幽王，周幽王极为喜爱，立即释放了褒珦并恢复其官职，褒姒从此入住王宫。

page_text_ocr_zh: 可是，褒姒从小生长在乡间，由于想念家乡和亲人，进宫后就再也没有笑过。这可把周幽王愁坏了。周幽王召来乐工，鸣钟击鼓，弹琴吹竽，还让宫人围着她和褒姒唱歌跳舞……可是，褒姒连嘴角都没有弯一下。
page_text_en: However, Bao Si had grown up in the countryside. Missing her hometown and family, she had not smiled once since entering the palace. This worried King You greatly. He summoned musicians to ring bells, beat drums, play the qin and the yu, and even had palace attendants surround her and dance and sing for her... Yet, Bao Si not even curved her lips.
summary_zh: 褒姒进宫后因思念家乡亲人而始终不笑，周幽王为此忧愁，召集乐工和宫人用歌舞音乐逗她开心，但褒姒依然面无表情。

page_text_ocr_zh:
周幽王苦恼地问褒姒："不喜欢听音乐，也不喜欢看跳舞，你到底喜欢什么呢？"
褒姒皱着眉头想了好一会儿，才温柔地说："我第一次跟着母亲去买布时，听到手撕布料的声音，又清脆又悦耳。"
周幽王高兴地说："你怎么不早说呢？快，搬一百匹上好的布料来！"
page_text_en:
King You of Zhou asked Bao Si anxiously, "You don't like music, nor do you like dancing. What exactly do you like?"
Bao Si frowned and thought for a while, then gently said, "The first time I followed my mother to buy cloth, I heard the sound of tearing fabric—it was crisp and pleasant."
King You happily said, "Why didn't you tell me earlier? Quickly, bring one hundred bolts of fine cloth!"
summary_zh: 周幽王为逗褒姒开心，询问她喜好，褒姒表示喜欢手撕布料的声音，周幽王随即下令搬来一百匹上好布料。

page_text_ocr_zh:
撕！
撕！
撕！
他专门挑了两个力气大的宫女，每天不停地撕布料，就为给褒姒听那个声音。可奇怪的是，褒姒听了，不但没有笑，反而流下了眼泪。
周幽王又愁眉苦脸起来："褒姒啊褒姒，你为什么还是不笑呢？谁要是能让你笑，我必重赏千金。"
page_text_en:
Tear!
Tear!
Tear!
He specially picked two strong palace maids, tearing cloth every day just to let Bao Si hear that sound. Strangely, when Bao Si heard it, she didn't laugh, but instead shed tears.
King You of Zhou frowned again: "Bao Si, Bao Si, why won't you smile? Whoever can make you laugh, I will reward with a thousand gold pieces."
summary_zh: 周幽王命宫女撕布料以逗褒姒发笑，但褒姒听后反而落泪，周幽王因此更加忧愁，并悬赏谁能让她笑。

page_text_ocr_zh: 朝中有个叫虢石父的大臣，给周幽王出主意："在王宫中，褒姒看到的不是楼阁殿宇，就是花草游鱼，时间长了，也没什么意思，大臣应该带她到外面玩一玩。" 周幽王觉得这个主意好，便带着褒姒坐上车，浩浩荡荡地去了骊山。
page_text_en: There was a minister named Guo Shifu in the court who gave King You of Zhou an idea: "In the palace, Bao Si sees nothing but pavilions and gardens, or flowers and fish. After a while, it becomes boring. Your Majesty should take her out for a trip." King You thought this was a good idea, so he took Bao Si in a carriage and set off grandly for Lishan Mountain.
summary_zh: 朝中大臣虢石父建议周幽王带褒姒出宫游玩，周幽王采纳建议，带着褒姒浩浩荡荡前往骊山。

page_text_ocr_zh: 一行人来到骊山，宫女们搭起帐子，铺上地毯，御厨们也架起了炊具，生火炖肉。褒姒坐在地毯上，放眼望去，只见青山一座连着一座，绿树像波涛一样随风起伏，一条弯弯曲曲的小溪从山间流出。二十多座烽火台，就藏在绿树青山之间。褒姒好像比在王宫中高兴点了，可她还是没有笑。
page_text_en: The group arrived at Lishan Mountain. The maids set up tents and laid down carpets, while the imperial chefs set up cooking utensils and started roasting meat. Bao Si sat on the carpet, looking around. She saw mountain after mountain, green trees swaying like waves in the wind, and a winding stream flowing from between the hills. More than twenty beacon towers were hidden among the green trees and mountains. Bao Si seemed happier than she was in the palace, but she still did not smile.
summary_zh: 周幽王带褒姒前往骊山游玩，宫女和御厨准备了帐篷、地毯和食物，褒姒虽比在宫中高兴些，但仍未展露笑容。

page_text_ocr_zh:
周幽王悄悄地走出帐子，突发奇想，指着烽火台，对跟随来的军士们说：‘你们去点燃烽火，再使劲儿擂起烽火台边的大鼓。’
褒姒与周幽王坐在帐中，吃着炖肉，喝着美酒，忽然听见外面鼓声震天，二十多座烽火台突然升起了熊熊大火。
page_text_en:
King You of Zhou quietly stepped out of the tent, had a sudden idea, pointed at the beacon towers, and said to the soldiers who followed him: 'Go light the beacon fires, and then vigorously beat the big drums beside the beacon towers.'
Bao Si and King You of Zhou sat in the tent, eating stewed meat and drinking fine wine, when suddenly they heard thunderous drumming outside, and more than twenty beacon towers erupted in roaring flames.
summary_zh: 周幽王为逗褒姒发笑，下令点燃烽火台并擂鼓，褒姒与周幽王在帐中饮酒吃肉，听见鼓声和看见烽火台燃起大火。

page_text_ocr_zh: "不好，犬戎入侵了！"各路诸侯看见烽火台上的大火，赶紧带着兵马跑到了骊山。可是，他们跑断了腿，跑掉了鞋，一个敌兵都没看见！只有周幽王和褒姒在赏景吃肉。褒姒看到各路诸侯军急急忙忙地跑来，紧张地观望了一阵后，又一个个垂头丧气地走了，觉得很滑稽。于是，她拍着手放声大笑起来。
page_text_en: "Oh no, the Quanrong are invading!" The feudal lords saw the great fire on the beacon tower and hurriedly brought their troops to Lishan. But, they ran themselves to exhaustion, losing their shoes, and saw not a single enemy soldier! Only King You of Zhou and Bao Si were enjoying the scenery and eating meat. Bao Si saw the feudal lords' armies rushing in anxiously, watched them nervously for a while, then saw them leave one by one, dejected and disappointed. She found the scene very comical. So, she clapped her hands and burst into loud laughter.
summary_zh: 周幽王点燃烽火台，各路诸侯率兵赶来救援，却发现并无敌兵，而周幽王与褒姒正在享乐。褒姒见诸侯们狼狈而归，觉得滑稽，于是拍手大笑。

page_text_ocr_zh: "哈哈，你终于笑了！"周幽王比褒姒还要高兴，马上赏了虢石父千金。为了哄褒姒开心，周幽王隔三岔五就点一次烽火，诸侯们被戏弄了一回又一回。几年后，犬戎真的打来了，周幽王再次点起烽火时，一个诸侯也没有来。犬戎杀了周幽王，攻破镐京，西周由此灭亡。
page_text_en: "Ha ha, you finally smiled!" King You of Zhou was even happier than Bao Si, and immediately rewarded Guo Shifu with a thousand pieces of gold. To please Bao Si, King You lit the beacon fires every now and then, and the feudal lords were tricked time and again. A few years later, when the Quanrong truly attacked, King You lit the beacon fires again, but not a single lord came. The Quanrong killed King You, captured Haojing, and the Western Zhou dynasty thus fell.
summary_zh: 周幽王因褒姒一笑而赏赐虢石父，并频繁点燃烽火戏弄诸侯。几年后犬戎入侵，周幽王再次点燃烽火却无人救援，最终被杀，西周灭亡。

page_text_ocr_zh: 周幽王喜欢美人，洪德就向他敬献了美女褒姒。洪德的“美人计”成功地救了自己的父亲，却没想到毁了整个西周。周幽王为了博褒姒一笑，竟然点燃烽火，戏弄诸侯。等到真正的敌人入侵时，烽火台燃得再旺、战鼓敲得再响，也没人来救他们了。
page_text_en: King You of Zhou loved beautiful women, so Hong De presented him with the beautiful Bao Si. Hong De's 'beauty strategy' successfully saved his father, but he never expected it would destroy the entire Western Zhou. In order to make Bao Si laugh, King You lit the beacon fires and mocked the feudal lords. When the real enemies invaded, even though the beacon towers burned fiercely and the war drums beat loudly, no one came to save them.
summary_zh: 本页总结了周幽王为博褒姒一笑而点燃烽火戏弄诸侯，最终在真正敌军入侵时无人救援，导致西周灭亡的历史教训。
